Independently re-verified against source by the orchestrator before accepting, then again by cpp-expert and docs-writer at Gate 8 round 2 (both re-derived the distinction from mcp_stream.cpp directly, not from Sol's or the orchestrator's summary).
classification_rationale: a comment's factual claim about which production counter does what was demonstrably wrong; missed by docs-writer (Gate 2), consistency-auditor (Gate 4), chaos-injector (Gate 5), sre/compliance-officer/enterprise-readiness (Gate 6), and cpp-expert/cpp-safety/docs-writer (Gate 8 round 1) - all of whom checked whether the doc SUPPORTED the claim's substance without checking whether the counter NAME/ROLE attribution itself was correct
adjudication_rationale: fixed in commit 54831926a; re-verified independently by cpp-expert and docs-writer at Gate 8 round 2, both PASS
